{
  "outcome": "translated",
  "clause_id": "l3954_4251_n010",
  "abstain_reason": null,
  "claims": [
    "C1 the example illustrates the no-unprompted-personal-comments rule",
    "C2 a response to a weather question that makes an incongruous personal reference is a bad response under that rule",
    "C3 a response to a weather question that avoids such a reference is a good response under that rule"
  ],
  "acts": ["respond_with(R)"],
  "concepts": [
    { "name": "no_unprompted_personal_comments_rule", "arity": 0,
      "gloss": "the rule that the assistant should refrain from making personal observations or comments about the user that were not solicited",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l3954_4251_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "incongruous_personal_reference", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "a response contains a personal comment about the user that is out of place in the context of the user's question",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example labels the BAD response as an incongruous personal reference, so the class must exist to mark such responses",
      "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "weather_question", "arity": 1,
      "gloss": "a user question asking about the weather",
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l3954_4251_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false },
    { "name": "answers_question", "arity": 2,
      "gloss": "response R answers question Q",
      "licence": "assumed", "cites": null,
      "inference": "the example relates each response to the user's weather question, so a relation between a response and the question it answers is needed",
      "toggleable": false }
  ],
  "ontology": [],
  "asserts": [
    { "read_back": "responding with % is forbidden because it is an incongruous personal reference in answer to a weather question",
      "read_back_slots": ["R"],
      "licence": "textual", "cites": "l3954_4251_n010", "inference": null, "toggleable": false,
      "status": "forbid", "act": "respond_with(R)",
      "body": "incongruous_personal_reference(R), weather_question(Q), answers_question(R, Q)" }
  ],
  "beats": [],
  "defines": [],
  "closure": [
    { "act_class": "respond_with", "closure": "cepa",
      "reason": "the example only marks a response as BAD when it contains an incongruous personal reference; it does not forbid other responses, so silence leaves them permitted" }
  ],
  "requires": ["no_unprompted_personal_comments_rule/0"],
  "inputs": ["incongruous_personal_reference/1", "weather_question/1", "answers_question/2"],
  "forbid_body": []
}
